pass_7147_pgl2_involution_schreier.weighted_operator: W=sum over all projective involutions acting on G/H
pass_7147_pgl2_involution_schreier.correction: A_pair=W-I-R, where R is the duplicate-support normalizer graph
pass_7147_pgl2_involution_schreier.R_structure: q(q+1)/2 disjoint copies of K_{h,h}, h=(q-1)/2
pass_7147_pgl2_involution_schreier.full_quotient_spectrum_status: THEOREM: the pair spectrum plus the exact fixed/pair incidence block proves the Pass7141 spectrum for every odd q.

pass_7148_m2_relative_compatibility.conflict_law: for R=M N^{-1}, conflict iff R11=+/-R22, equivalently tr(R)=0 or tr(DR)=0

pass_7149_d12_hexad_classification.membership_pattern: 6 singleton columns x32; 6 internal-pair columns x3; 9 cross-pair columns x4; two complementary triple columns x1

pass_7150_code_anatomy.shell_design_result: Every nonzero shell fails to be a 1-design on all 248 coordinates; the natural regularity is the membership-pattern stratification.
pass_7150_code_anatomy.D12_F2_module: F2^6 natural hexagon module; composition factors 1,1,V2,V2; primary dimensions 2 for (x+1)^2 and 4 for (x^2+x+1)^2.

pass_7151_bonkers_two_channel_factorizat.interpretation: The quotient conflict quartic factorizes into the original symplectic channel and its D-twisted channel; finite algebra only.

pass_7152_bonkers_symmetry_gap.statement: The extra six outer cosets preserve the code column multiset but are not induced by ambient PΓSp geometry.
